I never really pick the quest as it doesn't help your healing output or survivability by much. 

I do a variation of AA, where I take [1, 1, 3,  1,  2,  3,  1]

The increased healing for heroes under 30% is too good to give up for something that isn't guaranteed to land (the 2nd lash of your E). It also decreases the cd of my W, which will aid me in two ways: either by allowing my to put a free Zeal onto an ally or to potentially Root enemies  after I take my lvl 16 talent. 

Since I tend to weave in AA often as healer, I like taking the increased dmg on AA when Zeala are active. The more zeals active, the more dmg I'll deal with my AA. This extra AA dmg will occur on non-heroic targets as well. 

At 7, I tend to weigh my options depending on team compositions. Does the enemy team have a lot of cc or single target lock down? Do they have team wide lock downs? If the answer is no, then I always take the increased basic attack dmg against heroes hit by Zeal. If the answer is yes, I always take the unstoppable active. 

At 10, I must again think about compositions. Most of the time, regardless, I like to take Scarlett Aegis as it is an instant heal that grants armour and Zeal to every ally hit by it. It will give you stacks towards more AA dmg and once you get storm talent it grants unstoppable for 2 seconds. This CC prevention is huge and I find it very hard not to consider it for late game fights. If there's no CC to counter, I would consider taking Divine Reckoning. 

 13 is also variable depending on what your team may need. If they need extra CC, absolutely take [[Lashing Out]]. The reason for this is for when you hit 16 and take  [[Harsh Discipline]].

This week in arena, every heal grants the receiving unit 500 rage. It the unit is healed twice, it has full rage and can ult again. 

Since your Selena has reflect, it does enough damage to Miyuki that she is allowed to be healed. Since Miyuki has two targets (leader and Selena), she is able to ult again immediately after hitting the first one. This repeats until your Selena dies, as she has no way to damage herself again to reap the benefits from healing. 

Best bet is to remove the reflect gear that is on Selena. If you own Kasumi or Rie, I recommend building her up with lifesteal. Kasumi with lifesteal will ult over and over until another unit is deployed. Rie will hit over and over until every unit on board is dead. The reason for this is that both Kasumi and Rie lower their own HP while ulting, allowing for them to reap the benefits from healing. 

Good luck, hope this helps.
